source.raw_prompt: In demo-repo (task T-OBSLIVEC, run run-20261002-obsidianlive-004), loanflow.applicants.Business accepts a non-integer years_in_operation: Business(business_id="BZ-1", legal_name="Acme", years_in_operation=3.5) is constructed without error. Make Business reject a years_in_operation that is not a plain int with ValidationError, and add a regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py. Before scoping, consult the Obsidian vault for prior harness run summaries relevant to this kind of change, read each relevant one, and follow their precedent if the repository corroborates it.

objective: Make loanflow.applicants.Business.__post_init__ (demo-repo/src/loanflow/applicants.py:32-36) reject any years_in_operation that is not a plain int -- including float (e.g. 3.5, which currently constructs without error) and bool -- by raising loanflow.errors.ValidationError before the existing negative check, using the isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int) idiom already in the repository at demo-repo/src/loanflow/primitives.py:24, primitives.py:54 and risk_bands.py:46, and add a regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py. This follows the precedent of the Obsidian vault note LFCONV-INTGUARD-01 and the vault run summaries run-20261001-obsidianlive-002/-003 (retained at runs/run-20261002-obsidianlive-004/obsidian/read/read-1.json, read-2.json, read-3.json). The repository corroborates the idiom and its order. The two run summaries are stale as a record of current repository state, because their Applicant/late_fee_tier changes are not present in this checkout.
out_of_scope: The Applicant class in demo-repo/src/loanflow/applicants.py (years_employed validation is a separate change, not requested here)
demo-repo/src/loanflow/primitives.py and demo-repo/src/loanflow/risk_bands.py (the convention to follow, not to change)
demo-repo/src/loanflow/late_fee_tier.py and any caller of Business
Changing the years_in_operation default, the negative-value check, or the legal_name check
Adding a new dependency or a shared validation helper
constraints: In demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py, only add a regression test for non-int years_in_operation rejection following the existing test_business_rejects_negative_years_in_operation pattern; do not modify existing tests
Reuse the existing repository idiom exactly: isinstance(self.years_in_operation, bool) or not isinstance(self.years_in_operation, int)
Raise loanflow.errors.ValidationError (already imported in applicants.py), never TypeError or ValueError
The type check must run before the negative check; existing negative and empty-legal_name behavior must be preserved unchanged
Follow TDD: add the failing regression test before the source change
No new dependency for a change this small

acceptance_criteria.description: Business(business_id="BZ-1", legal_name="Acme", years_in_operation=3.5) raises loanflow.errors.ValidationError, asserted by a new regression test in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py
Business constructed with years_in_operation=True raises loanflow.errors.ValidationError (bool is an int subclass and must be explicitly excluded), asserted by the same new regression test

The pre-existing tests test_valid_business_constructs, test_business_rejects_empty_legal_name and test_business_rejects_negative_years_in_operation in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py still pass unmodified
demo-repo/tests/unit/test_applicants.py passes as a whole, and the full demo-repo unit suite (tests/unit) remains green

task_graph.description: Confirm the current Business.__post_init__ body, the exact repository integer-guard idiom (file:line), the existing test conventions in test_applicants.py, and whether any in-repo caller constructs Business with a non-int years_in_operation; record whether each consulted vault note is corroborated, stale, contradicted or context-only.
Add a failing regression test for float and bool years_in_operation, then add the type guard at the top of the years_in_operation checks in Business.__post_init__.
Independently re-run the narrow test file and the full unit suite and confirm every acceptance criterion.
